address_convention: Hexadecimal numbers are zero-based Modbus PDU addresses. A table prefix 0/1/3/4 denotes coils/discrete-input/input-register/holding-register space, not an address digit. Decimal reference columns usually add one, but contain documented inconsistencies; never convert those columns blindly.
firmware_scope_warning: Manual revision is NOT firmware revision. No manual provides a complete per-register minimum-firmware availability matrix.

patterns.claim: Channels append by installed channel count within their own DI/AI/DO/AO stream, not by fixed module stride.
patterns.counterexample: An 8DI expansion does not shift AI, DO or AO addresses.

patterns.claim: Numeric base 0 recurs in four separate Modbus tables; float families use two words and stride two.
patterns.counterexample: AI process IR0x0BB8 differs from AO process HR0x01F4; PT100 IR0x0DAC differs from AI range HR0x0DAC.

patterns.claim: Detailed networking/negotiation block repeats across non-U, U and LoRa documents.
patterns.counterexample: Shared base does not preserve all write function codes, filter addresses or per-channel scope.

counterexamples.claim: Non-U HR0x0DA3 is global, 1..16; U HR0x1388 is per-channel, table 1..65535.
Non-U HR0x0DA2 is global, 1..16; U table HR0x0FA0 is per-channel, 0..4, while U prose still says 0x0DA2. U0 default6 is outside its own table range; U1 default0.
N1/L1 document W06/W10 at 0x7584/0x7585; U0/U1 list W06 only.
Non-U/expansion/LoRa prose0x0DAC conflicts with table0x1194; U prose/table agree0x1194. This favors a copied prose error, not verified non-U hardware.
U maximum16 including host, 32 model/firmware slots, 16 storage flags and 32 bitmap bits are not interchangeable capacities.

reference_conflicts.claim: Printed 8DI continuation0x0008..0x0010 has nine addresses; eight channels end0x000F.
Non-U AO process prints3-0501 while table/FC identify holding registers; normalized4-0501 is computed, not a replacement quote.
U decimal reference fields omit/duplicate +1; online error table0x7587/4-30087 conflicts with detailed4-30088.
